# Phase 6 Audit Diff

## A. Full pytest result

pytest -q → **200 passed in 19.78s**.

pytest -q tests/test_phase6_vol_target.py → **44 passed in 2.97s**.

## B. Dedicated Phase 6 test count

The dedicated suite tests/test_phase6_vol_target.py contains 44 collected tests (including parametrized cases).

## C. Exact grid/count verification

- parameter_grid() = (20, 40, 60) × (0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30).
- Assets = SPY, QQQ, SSO, QLD; TQQQ is excluded/locked.
- 4 assets × 4 frequencies × 3 windows × 5 targets = 240 economic combinations.
- metrics_pre_tax.csv = 240; metrics_after_tax.csv = 240; vol_parameter_surface.csv = 480; parameter_results.csv = 240.
- Every (asset, frequency, vol_window, target_vol, tax_mode) occurs exactly once.
- parameter_results is the 240-row enumeration with searched_for_selection=False and selection_performed=False everywhere.

## D. Asset/signal convention audit

The existing asset-specific convention is preserved: each asset uses its own adjusted-close realized volatility to control that same asset (SPY→SPY, QQQ→QQQ, SSO→SSO, QLD→QLD). The frozen text does not specify an alternative subset or underlying substitution, so no economic redesign was made. TQQQ remains excluded. This is an implementation convention, not a newly frozen rule.

## E. Exact realized-volatility formula audit

The actual call path uses adjusted close, daily_return_t = price_t / price_(t−1) − 1, rolling(L, min_periods=L).std(ddof=1), and annualization sqrt(252). The current close t participates in vol_t; the first valid value is at index L and requires L+1 prices. Deterministic 20D, 40D, and 60D tests independently reproduce the formula. An additional test covers extremely small positive volatility.

## F. Target-weight and clipping audit

raw_weight_t = target_vol / realized_vol_t, followed by clip to [0,1]. Tests cover realized volatility above/equal/below target, very high volatility, all five frozen targets, finite bounds, no margin, and no short exposure. Remaining wealth is CASH.

## G. Zero-volatility and warm-up behavior

Zero-volatility ratios are clipped to 1.0 by the existing operation order; NaN pre-warm-up decisions are filled to 0. No NaN or infinity enters the portfolio.

## H. Close-t → next-open no-lookahead audit

Parameterized 20D and 60D integration cases at weekly and monthly frequency show a final close changes only the subsequent eligible target, execution uses the next open and 5 bps delta-notional cost, and future mutation after the cutoff leaves prior targets unchanged.

## I. Double-scheduling audit

The runner supplies volatility_target_next_open (one shift plus the frequency mask) and the same schedule gate to continuous_weight_backtest. Tests verify one close→next-open delay, no extra lag, and no daily resizing.

## J. Rebalance-schedule audit

Weekly, monthly, bi-monthly (odd months Jan/Mar/May/Jul/Sep/Nov), and quarterly masks use the first available trading session, including holiday/missing-first-session cases. Between scheduled sessions targets are held constant.

## K. Continuous-weight accounting audit

Synthetic 0.25→0.60, 0.80→0.30, 0.70→0.45, 0→1, and 1→0 cases pass. Trades use the current open, delta notional, and 5 bps cost; cash and shares remain non-negative and risky weight stays within [0,1].

## L. Partial-sale tax audit

Profitable partial sales, loss-making sales, full exits, repeated partial sales, average basis, tax-before-buy, loss pools, remaining basis, and later re-entry pass. Tax-ledger rows are sale-only and cumulative realized tax is monotone.

## M. CASH audit

CASH has exactly 0% return. Risk plus cash equals 100%; no leverage, short, or negative cash is present. Initial all-CASH sessions remain at initial equity.

## N. Warm-up/calendar audit

Pre-start rows are warm-up only and produce no pre-evaluation ledger, positions, trades, or tax. The complete evaluation calendar has zero missing aligned targets, opens, or adjusted closes.

## O. Turnover audit

Annual turnover is sum(abs(trade_notional) / contemporaneous_open_pretrade_equity) / calendar_years. Initial deployment BUY and hypothetical terminal liquidation are excluded; partial BUY/SELL rebalances are included. Phase 6 reuses the canonical Phase 2 _turnover_audit helper after reporting-only pretrade-equity reconstruction. The generated phase6_report.md contains one representative decomposition for every asset/frequency.

## P. Holding-period audit

Completed episodes are zero→positive→zero risky-share episodes measured in trading sessions. Partial changes do not end an episode and open terminal positions are excluded. Every historical cell ends with a positive risky holding, so regenerated mean/median/max fields are explicit N/A rather than stale 7376 calendar duration.

## Q. Tax and terminal-liquidation audit

After-tax primary wealth is wealth after realized tax paid to date. After-tax rows include after_tax_wealth_tax_paid_to_date, after_tax_cagr_tax_paid_to_date, cumulative_realized_tax_paid, terminal liquidation wealth/CAGR/tax/cost/unrealized gain, and tax_semantics. Terminal liquidation is non-mutating and creates no SELL.
